![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Add a defensive guard to filter `raw_candidate_results` to only valid objects before mapping over them to prevent potential `TypeErrors`.

```javascript
  const triById = new Map(
    (Array.isArray(inputs.triangulationValidator?.raw_candidate_results)
      ? inputs.triangulationValidator.raw_candidate_results
      : [])
      .filter((result) => result && typeof result === 'object')
      .map((result) => [result.assertion_id, result]),
  );
```
